'''Senex''' was an [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] in the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]]. Offworlders were restricted to the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Space station/Legends|space stations]] and a small number of [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]].
